market_summary: US Q3 GDP advance came in at a 3.4% annualised pace (Q2 2.2%), while headline PCE inflation rose to 3.6% y/y in September and sped up. The Nasdaq was down about 1% at 11:37 ET Thursday as Alphabet fell about 10% on a search and ad miss, with the S&P 500 and Dow slightly lower and Microsoft up about 3% on Azure. The 10-year yield eased to about 4.98% from 5.05% and Brent fell 2.1% to about $109. The ECB held its deposit rate at 2.50% and Lagarde said she will step down on Feb 7, 2027; markets lean to a December hike. Hang Seng fell 0.6% to 22,958.65. Midday read, not the close. Next: Amazon, Axos, Rocket results ~7am AEDT Fri; Apple Mon after close = Tue morning AEDT; RBA Tue 2:30pm AEDT.

Marvell down about 11% on reports it is in advanced talks to buy Lumentum; take moved to watch.
